messages:
alice.j: Heads-up — planning a schema change for user_events tonight 02:00 UTC (quiet window). We'll ADD COLUMN event_type and run a batched async backfill. Expect short DDL lock (~<30s/shard).

deploybot: Scheduled deploy: canary @ 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z -> rolling. Steps: apply DDL on canary, wait 10m, start backfill workers. See deploy ID: db-deploy-176900.

alice.j: SQL we'll run:
```sql
ALTER TABLE user_events ADD COLUMN event_type text;
-- start backfill after DDL
SELECT start_async_backfill('user_events', 'event_type', 'event_type_source');
```

dave.sre: Oncall: please add quiesce window 01:50-03:20 UTC. If any lock > 5m, abort backfill and escalate. Also enable slow-query logging.

carol: We're going to pin webapp to 3.2.1 during the window to avoid schema-advancing writes. I'll update the deploy config.

bob.k: If the backfill spikes p99 writes, what's the escape hatch?

alice.j: Escape hatch: 1) flip feature flag `evt_type_ready` -> off; 2) stop backfill jobs gracefully (`ctrl-c` to controller) which flushes batches; 3) if app-level issues persist, revert webapp to pinned v3.2.1. Full DDL rollback is last-resort (dropping column) and only if column has no data.

elena.pm: I'll draft release notes and the ops playbook. Include: risk (possible 5-10% write latency bump during backfill), rollback steps, monitoring dashboard links. PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pulls/234

deploybot: Canary complete — DDL applied on canary with no long locks. Rolling to remaining nodes. Monitor window: 02:10-03:10 UTC.

dave.sre: Watching metrics now. If sustained write latency >30% for >10m, execute escape hatch: run `kill_backfill_jobs --graceful` and set `evt_type_ready=false`. Post a short incident in #incidents.

alice.j: Pushed migration scripts + backfill controller changes to the deploy branch. Tagging QA for verification.

carol: Tagging #eng-oncall and #prod-notify. If anyone sees anything odd ping @alice.j directly. :thumbsup:

bob.k: Noted. Will watch RPS and replica lag.

elena.pm: Release notes PR updated with rollback playbook and the link to the monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123/user-events-backfill

alice.j: Final: feature flag will remain off until backfill job finishes and we run a short canary on writes. Thanks all.
